title: S4 - numeric level labels destroy a Score
note: The docs claim a model that is given bare numbers as levels has nothing to match the state against. Documented: descriptive levels put the misaligned-button report at 0.0 with confidence 1.0; numeric levels give 0.55 at confidence 0.33. Reproducing this settles whether level wording is real engineering or superstition. Observed: the degradation is confined to the middle of the scale. On an unmistakable top-of-scale report, numeric levels answered 2.0 at confidence 0.97, so bare numbers cost almost nothing where the state is extreme.
